findings.detail: Under the assumption: keyhole at (-60, 45): entry 11.0, slot 5.20 running 10.0 mm, 0 degrees from up
findings.assumption: The wall screws' heads are 9 mm across, so a keyhole works if its entry passes a 9 mm head and its slot carries the head clear of the entry, in place of matching the one keyhole that hung (10.5 mm entry, 12 mm slot).
